morbi.headline: Morbi tile makers face margin pressures from propane hikes despite strong housing demand.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic manufacturers are considering strategic shifts and passing on price adjustments due to rising propane costs.
Industry units organized a boycott against Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) to oppose recent propane price increases.
The overall tile sector is experiencing strong housing demand and outperforming peer segments on pricing.
stress_signals: Propane fuel price hikes impacting input costs for Morbi ceramic units [6396a32f35e0]
Morbi ceramic industry boycotting IOCL over contested propane price increases [a7d86eb38db4]
improvement_signals: Tile sector outperforming peers driven by price hikes and robust housing demand [edc2b0a0e70b]
what_to_watch: Resolution of the IOCL propane boycott and potential supply disruptions to kiln operations.
Impact of propane price increases on borrower working capital cycles and operating margins.
Ability of MSME tile units to successfully pass on fuel cost hikes to end consumers amid housing demand.

surat.headline: Textile demand and global interest rise, but payment defaults and diamond input costs pressure liquidity.
what_changed: Global apparel brands and wedding season are lifting demand expectations for Surat's textile units.
Input costs for lab-grown diamonds surged following a 10% hike in Chinese HPHT rough prices.
Textile industry bodies flagged multi-crore payment defaults and sought legal protections under BNS.
Textile manufacturers face a potential 9.74% additional tax burden unless machinery duty exemptions are extended.
stress_signals: SGCCI demanded BNS amendments to curb mounting multi-crore payment defaults and fraud across the textile trade [c3927b4b71cd].
A Katargam diamond trader suffered a Rs 1.27 crore fraud involving 1,035.15 carats of polished stones taken by a Mota Varachha broker [e8488d4182be].
Surat lab-grown diamond polishers face margin squeeze as Chinese HPHT synthetic rough diamond prices climbed 10% [becb969c5c01].
Textile units risk an impending 9.74% tax burden if the duty exemption on textile machinery is not extended to 2032 [c4aec41167e8].
improvement_signals: Around 100 international garment brands are redirecting inquiries toward Surat due to political unrest in Bangladesh [084fb4124b58].
The domestic textile sector anticipates a 15% to 20% business increase driven by the wedding season [ee10e4ca8235].
Softening man-made fibre (MMF) yarn prices offer cost relief to weavers amid wedding-driven demand recovery [46a77985a471].
what_to_watch: Debtor aging cycles and trade receivable realization rates in MMF textile accounts amid reports of rising payment defaults.
Working capital absorption and operating margins among lab-grown diamond polishers absorbing the 10% HPHT rough price hike.
Government policy decision regarding the requested machinery duty exemption extension through 2032 to avoid a 9.74% levy.
Conversion of international garment brand inquiries and export outreach into bankable, verified order books.
